justification: Changes what the property provisions API serves (clause label and first-line code hidden unless proven) and adds a schema column plus a post-publish writer. Not Critical: additive column, the serving change only removes an unproven number and keeps the page; unchecked rows (NULL) are served exactly as before. Not Minor: it changes served regulatory citations.

pre_impl.existing_data: No citation column existed on regulatory_provisions (information_schema, 2026-09-26). The verdict is the existing scripts/citation_proof.prove_citation_any; served rows and cached page lines are the DQ-111 probe's own SERVED_SQL and chapter_lines.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed every served label came from parseRefNumber in for-property; confirmed by grep: clause_label is built only at route.ts enrichWithTocSections (two return paths), both now go through withServedCitation.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive: two nullable columns and an index. Writer updates only rows whose verdict changed (17,489 written on the first run).
pre_impl.external_source_error: A chapter PDF that cannot be downloaded is recorded as no_source (hidden), never as proven.
pre_impl.frontend_type: citation_status is text|null from the DB; withServedCitation returns clause_label string|null and citation_shown boolean; PageGroupedProvisions already renders clause_label only when truthy.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the writer never runs, citation_status stays NULL and numbers are served as before (visible as no change, not as wrong data). If it wrongly marks a true number unproven, the page is still shown, so the citation stays true.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: an unproven status still yields a clause_label or the stored code on the first line, or an unknown verdict is written
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Tests pass (3 jest, 3 pytest). Live: citation_status written for all 17,489 served DCP rows -- 13,701 proven, 2,696 not_proven, 627 unjudged, 249 imprecise, 216 text_not_found.

functions.name: withServedCitation
functions.input: a provision row with citation_status/ref_number/provision_text and the parsed clause label
functions.output: the row with clause_label null and the stored code stripped from the first line unless proven or imprecise
functions.if_none: citation_status NULL means not checked: served unchanged

functions.name: plan_updates
functions.if_none: an unknown verdict raises ValueError instead of being stored

queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND rp.source_council IS NOT NULL, joined to the active registry row
UPDATE ... WHERE p.id = v.id AND p.is_current, 500 ids per statement

break_it.scenario: A dry-run publish triggers the verdict writer with --apply
break_it.what_happens: a dry run would write verdicts to the production database
break_it.how: the post-step loops over committed_councils only when not dry_run
break_it.repro: python scripts/dcp_commit_approved.py (no --commit): committed_councils stays empty and the post-step loop is guarded by `not dry_run`

break_it.scenario: A first line that carries a different code than the stored one
break_it.what_happens: the council title text after a longer code would be cut off wrongly
break_it.how: only the exact stored code (normalised) is removed; test asserts C4.10 is kept when the stored code is C4.1
break_it.repro: npx jest __tests__/lib/citation-display.test.ts -- asserts stripStoredCode('# C4.10 Fences', 'Doc__chap__C4_1') is unchanged

break_it.scenario: Served DCP rules query misses a chapter (no active registry row), so its rules are never judged
break_it.what_happens: those rules keep citation_status NULL and are served as before, unverified
break_it.how: NULL is the explicit 'not checked' state and never shown as proven; the count of NULL served rows is visible by query
break_it.repro: SELECT count(*) FROM regulatory_provisions WHERE is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND citation_status IS NULL  -- 0 after the 2026-09-26 run

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a property report for a council with unproven citations (e.g. Warringah) and confirm unproven rules show no clause label but keep their page.
